title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Product Assigned When a Record Opens
content:
## Clause

Every Demurrage and Detention Free Time record starts life on whichever product applies to its container at the moment of opening, and only two products can be applied at that moment.

- **AHL Contract Free Time 30** — for a booking rated under an active service contract held by the same customer, provided that contract's tier rank reaches at least the minimum tier rank the product sets.
- **AHL Tariff Free Time** is applied in every other case.

Opening on AHL Contract Free Time 30 depends on the contract named on the booking showing as active in the company's contract records; that status is checked there before the record opens.

In addition, the product has to accept the rate class that the equipment class map gives the container. Where a contract booking's equipment belongs to a class the contract product does not accept, its record is opened on the tariff product.

No other product of the range can be on a record when it opens; those products reach a record only through an upgrade bought later while its free time runs.

## When each record opens

- **Export:** the release of empty equipment against the booking is the moment the record comes into existence.
- **Import:** the container's discharge is what creates the record.

## Decision table

| Booking rated under a contract of the same customer | Contract tier rank meets the product minimum | Contract active | Container class accepted by the contract product | Product at opening |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes | AHL Contract Free Time 30 |
| yes | yes | no | any | AHL Tariff Free Time |
| yes | no | any | any | AHL Tariff Free Time |
| yes | yes | yes | no | AHL Tariff Free Time |
| no | not relevant | not relevant | not relevant | AHL Tariff Free Time |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A booking rated under the same customer's active contract of a sufficient tier opens its import records on AHL Contract Free Time 30 on the discharge date.
- The same booking whose contract has lapsed from active status opens on AHL Tariff Free Time, whatever the tier.
